about: Shot list and picks file for the Lumora editorial photography (golden-hour.md 4.4 brief, section 6 slots). Fill photographer, source_url (Unsplash photo page), image_url (images.unsplash.com/photo-...) or local_file, and alt after looking at the photo, then run: python3 build_set.py shot-list.json --orig <folder outside the repo>
rules: Free Unsplash photos only: search with ?license=free; never plus.unsplash.com or premium_photo
Low warm sun (side or back light, about 3000-3800 K), hard leaf or window shadows; indoor window light as often as outdoor
Every set of four skin images spans Fitzpatrick I to VI, ages 25 to 60, all genders; real texture kept
Anonymous editorial mood: eyes closed, profile or cropped; no smiles at camera; no face presented as a named person or a customer

Avoid: beaches, swimwear, sunbathing or tanning cues, glitter or shimmer, heavy retouching, teal-orange or cool grades, silhouettes with no skin detail, visible brands, logos, labelled products or text tattoos, anything that could pass as a before-and-after
Prefer clean negative space; crops 4:5 portraits and cards, 3:4 gallery tiles, 16:9 bands only

picks.subject: Fitzpatrick I-II: cheek, jaw or shoulder in low warm sun with leaf shadow, eyes closed or profile; freckles welcome
Fitzpatrick III-IV: profile or collarbone in warm late window light
Fitzpatrick IV-V: jawline or neck in raking sun, eyes closed
Fitzpatrick V-VI: cheekbone or shoulder catching golden light, leaf or window shadow
